data.name: Sharvanik
data.gender_notes: Sharvanik is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sharvanik is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sharva' which means 'spring'. This name is a perfect representation of the new beginnings and fresh starts that come with the arrival of spring. It is also symbolic of youth, vitality, and renewal. The name Sharvanik carries the meaning “Spring, Freshness, Youth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharvanik usually hope their child will grow to embody spring, freshness, youth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sharvanik is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality. It is believed that this name brings with it the blessings of the gods and the promise of a fulfilling and abundant life.
data.etymology: Sharvanik belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Spring, Freshness, Youth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharvanik total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sharvanik holds great significance in Hindu culture, as it embodies the spirit of rebirth and revival that characterizes the spring season. In India, this season is celebrated with various festivals, including Holi, which mark the arrival of spring and the triumph of good over evil. The name is also reminiscent of the vibrant colors and lush greenery that are associated with this time of year.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, Sharvanik represents the cyclical nature of life and the inherent potential for growth and transformation that exists within each of us. At its core, this name invites us to embrace the energies of renewal and rejuvenation, and to tap into the innate resilience and vitality that lie within. By carrying this name, one is constantly reminded of the power of new beginnings and the opportunity to create a fresh and meaningful existence.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sharvanik is a name derived from the Sanskrit word "Sharva," which represents Lord Shiva, and "Nik," signifying the one who brings blessings. Thus, Sharvanik symbolizes the divine presence of Lord Shiva, bestowing his blessings upon the bearer.
